changelog: Text fields across sign-in, Device Name, Name, Linked Email, Redeem and Feedback now use the handoff's filled card with the rule and the disc-shaped clear control.

Display Icon and Battery Priority are bottom sheets over the settings list, with the close button above the title; Display Icon drops the labels and the Device / Custom tiles the design does not have.
Feedback is a bottom sheet again and has its contact-email field back; Redeem matches the same sheet chrome.
Device Name lost the device picker the design does not draw, Device Info's Model row lost its chevron, and battery health no longer prints a space before the percent sign.
Add Device centres its header title and puts the headline and radar art on the design's pixels; the onboarding radar moves up 25.
Settings starts its profile block and section heading on the design's pixels and shows the display name instead of the registration account; Insights hides Share when there is no device.
Battery Priority reads "Backup Mode" on the settings row, the notification title is "Low Battery", and a dim header Save is primary at 30% rather than grey.
